privacyDoc.intro: This policy explains what SuwaLink collects when you use it, why, and what you can do about it.
privacyDoc.collectBody: Your name, email, phone number, preferred language and district, and the reservations and prescription requests you make.
privacyDoc.prescriptionsBody: A prescription image is shared only with the pharmacies you choose when you upload it. Images of closed or expired requests are deleted automatically after a set period.
privacyDoc.useBody: To show pharmacies your reservations and requests, to send you notifications and emails about them, and to keep the service secure.
privacyDoc.rightsBody: You can change your details in Settings at any time, and delete your account there. Deleting removes your personal details and prescription images.

termsDoc.intro: These terms apply when you use SuwaLink to find, reserve or supply medicines.
termsDoc.serviceBody: SuwaLink shows medicine availability reported by pharmacies. Stock and prices can change; the pharmacy confirms them when you collect.
termsDoc.accountsBody: Keep your password private and your details accurate. Pharmacies must hold a valid licence and are verified before they appear.
termsDoc.reservationsBody: A reservation holds medicines for a limited time. Prescription medicines are handed over only against a valid prescription.
termsDoc.adviceBody: SuwaLink does not give medical advice. Ask a doctor or pharmacist about any medicine.
